name: Pentorex
summary: Pentorex, also known as phenpentermine or α,β-dimethylamphetamine and sold under the brand name Modatrop, is a stimulant drug of the amphetamine family related to phentermine (α-methylamphetamine) which is used as an anorectic to assist with weight loss. It also acts as a diuretic. Pentorex was developed by Nordmark in the 1960s.

uses.text: Pentorex, also known as phenpentermine or α,β-dimethylamphetamine and sold under the brand name Modatrop, is a stimulant drug of the amphetamine family related to phentermine (α-methylamphetamine) which is used as an anorectic to assist with weight loss. Pentorex was developed by Nordmark in the 1960s.

summaryZh: 噴托雷司又稱α,β-二甲基苯丙胺，化學式為C11H17N。它是與芬特明相關的興奮劑，也是可以幫助減肥的降食慾劑。此外，它還是利尿劑。噴托雷司於1960年代開發。

pharmacology.en: Like phentermine it acts as a releasing agent for noradrenaline, which is what reduces appetite, with relatively little effect on serotonin.
pharmacology.zh: 與芬特明一樣，它是正腎上腺素的釋放劑，這正是它抑制食慾的原因，對血清素的影響則相對較小。
pharmacology.zhHans: 与芬特明一样，它是正肾上腺素的释放剂，这正是它抑制食欲的原因，对血清素的影响则相对较小。

sideEffects.en: Drugs of its class, the stimulants, can cause a fast heart rate, raised blood pressure, overheating, anxiety, sleeplessness and, with repeated use, dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 它所屬的興奮劑類藥物，可能引起心跳加快、血壓上升、體溫過高、焦慮、失眠，反覆使用還可能導致成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它所属的兴奋剂类药物，可能引起心跳加快、血压上升、体温过高、焦虑、失眠，反复使用还可能导致成瘾。

fact.en: It is phentermine with one more methyl group, and like phentermine it was sold as an appetite suppressant, under the name Modatrop.
fact.zh: 它是在芬特明上多加一個甲基的產物，和芬特明一樣曾作為食慾抑制劑販售，商品名為 Modatrop。
fact.zhHans: 它是在芬特明上多加一个甲基的产物，和芬特明一样曾作为食欲抑制剂贩售，商品名为 Modatrop。
